messages.subject: Dissertation aRt Recap
parts:
Hey everyone,

Just wanted to send a belated THANK YOU to everyone who helped out with our Dissertation aRt event a couple weeks back.  We had fantastic time, ended up staying up way later than we intended to because we all got so in to making our plots, and best of all, we now have a collection of data art!

If you missed out on the event but still want to contribute one or more plots, let me know!  I'd be happy to help you make it happen.  Finally, if you're looking for the perfect gift for the R nerd in your life (including yourself!), all the stuff in the Davis R-Users Group Society6 store is 20% off until tomorrow if you use this link:

https://society6.com/davisrusersgroup?promo=HHBP68WYXJ48

All proceeds will be going to a Data Carpentry fund for workshops for underfunded groups and/or under-represented locations.


Thanks so much!  We'll be adding the Society6 store page permalink to our website, where you can find it any time in the future.

Best wishes,
Myfanwy
--
